verdict.rationale: Fellow documents an official MCP Server across its developer docs, help center and feature page. It lets AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor query meeting recaps, notes and action items without code, and admins control which tools are exposed, revoke connections and see last-used timestamps. A probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the connector works as described.
